spans.s:
मेल मेल, अस्, आ, m. f. (fr. rt. मिल्), meeting,
coming together, union, intercourse; an assembly,
company, society; (in modern dialects) a large con-
course of people collected at stated periods for reli-
gious or commercial purposes; a fair; (आ), f. a
musical scale; (with Buddhists) a particular high
number; any black substance used for writing, ink-
powder, ink, (in this and the following senses pro-
bably connected with Gr. μέλας); antimony, eye-
salve; the indigo plant.
—मेला-नन्द, अस्, आ, m. f.
an ink-bottle; [cf. मेला-मन्दा below.]
—मेला-
नन्दाय, Nom. A. मेलानन्दायते, &c., to be-
come an ink-bottle.
—मेलान्धु, उस्, f. (? m.) or
मेलान्धुक (˚ला-अन्˚), अस्, m. an ink-bottle.
—मे-
ला-मन्दा, f. an ink-bottle.
—मेलाम्बु, उस्, m. an
ink-bottle; (probably for मेलान्धु.)

मेलक, अस्, m. meeting, union, coming together,
intercourse; a congress, assembly, a company [cf.
नटक-म्˚]; मेलकं कृ, to assemble together;
ग्रह-मेलक, a conjunction of the planets.
—मे-
लक-लवण, अम्, n. a kind of salt (= मृत्तिका-
लवण; cf. क्षार-मेलक, क्षार-मृत्तिका).

मेलन, अम्, n. the act of meeting, union, coming
together, junction, assembling, associating with; an
encounter; mixing with, mixture; adding to.

मेलयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. the Caus.), causing to
be mixed or added to, mixing, adding.

मेलापक, अस्, m. (fr. the Caus.), uniting, bring-
ing together; conjunction (of planets).
मेलायन, अम्, n. mixing together, combination.

मेलु and मेलुद, (with Buddhists) a particular
high number.
